widgets_values: Convert reference images of poses and expressions into character design images.Maintain the character’s original head-to-body ratio

输出图片的动作尺寸和比例主要根据参考图决定，所以尽量选相似比例的参考图，例如动漫人物如果选择真人的动作参考，在人物的比例上就会有所差别

The action size and proportion of the output image are mainly determined by the reference image. Therefore, it is advisable to select a reference image with a similar proportion. For example, if a real person's action reference is used for an anime character, there will be differences in the character's proportion.

这里放入参考人物全身像，如果姿势是侧面就用侧面像，姿势是背面就用背面像

Place a full-body image of the reference character here. If the pose is a side view, use a side profile image; if the pose is a back view, use a back profile image.
